title: Simultaneous equations as two lines
caption: Each equation is a line in the (v₁, v₂) plane. Momentum, v₁ + 2v₂ = 6, and the elastic condition, v₂ − v₁ = 6, meet at one point: v₁ = -2 m s⁻¹, v₂ = 4 m s⁻¹. Only that point satisfies both laws, so the solution is where the lines cross.
alt: Two straight lines in the plane of the final velocities v1 and v2 crossing at v1 equals minus 2, v2 equals 4 metres per second.
description: Horizontal axis: v₁ (final velocity of the 1.0 kg ball); vertical axis: v₂ (the 2.0 kg ball), both in m s⁻¹.
Momentum conservation, 6 = v₁ + 2v₂, is the line v₂ = (6 − v₁)/2, sloping down.
Elastic collision (relative speed reverses), v₂ − v₁ = 6, is the line v₂ = v₁ + 6, sloping up.
They cross at (-2, 4): the 1.0 kg ball bounces back at 2 m s⁻¹ and the 2.0 kg ball moves off at 4 m s⁻¹.

checks.name: the two lines meet at v₁ = −2.0, v₂ = 4.0 m s⁻¹
